🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, with Sector Strength: Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive. Leadership: intermediate (Top 5 spread across 3 sectors; neither Narrow nor Broad); Technology is recovering while several major stocks diverge across timeframes, so the broad sector advance is not a clean directional signal.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads on the week but remains in RECOVERY: MPC (1W: +11.24% | 1M: -13.06%) and VLO (1W: +9.63% | 1M: -14.46%). Technology is also in RECOVERY at the sector level, with AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%); Communication is firmer, led by CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary, Healthcare, and Real Estate are the weakest relative sectors on the week, though all posted positive sector returns. Consumer Discretionary includes F BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -2.08%); Healthcare includes PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%) and ISRG in CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.68%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD in RECOVERY (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%), CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%), LRCX in RECOVERY (1W: +12.71% | 1M: -18.58%), and CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +1.89%). Leadership: intermediate (3 sectors represented); notable weekly strength, but several technology leaders remain below their monthly levels.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -14.41%), ISRG in CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.68%), NEE in CORRECTION (1W: -2.10% | 1M: +7.80%), and F BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -2.08%). Weakness is mixed across sectors rather than concentrated in one broad market group.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AMD in RECOVERY (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%), and CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%). MAJOR divergence across key stocks—including GOOGL in RECOVERY (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -15.31%), META in RECOVERY (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -12.90%), and CAT in RECOVERY (1W: +7.44% | 1M: -18.22%)—makes this a tactical move, not confirmation of a durable trend.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is in RECOVERY at the sector level: +4.28% for 1W versus -9.21% for 1M; constituent breadth was not supplied (24 stocks). AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) and TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +9.30%) contrast with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%); AMD remains in RECOVERY (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are firm at the sector level, +2.59% for 1W and +4.11% for 1M; constituent breadth was not supplied (20 stocks). JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +6.70%), and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +7.28%) show continued strength, while COF is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is positive at the sector level, +1.05% for 1W and +4.62% for 1M; constituent breadth was not supplied (17 stocks). JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +12.82%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +15.47%) lead, while PFE remains BELOW TREND (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio stance?
Stay selective in the NEUTRAL regime: favor confirmed strength in JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) and CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%), while monitoring technology’s uneven rebound. Style mixed / no clear leadership; the 11/11 positive sector breadth is encouraging, but major stock-level divergences argue against a strong style call.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) and JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) if their positive weekly momentum holds. BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) remains at risk absent stabilization; AMD in RECOVERY (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) needs follow-through to confirm a trend turn.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication, with sector returns of +3.52% for 1W and +5.03% for 1M; Technology is worth monitoring for follow-through after a +4.28% weekly rebound against a -9.21% monthly decline. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary is the weakest weekly sector at +0.68%, while Energy’s +6.25% weekly gain remains a recovery against -2.97% for 1M; all 11/11 sectors were positive on the week.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so use return-based triggers: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) needs weekly stabilization; AMD in RECOVERY (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) needs continued strength to confirm a reversal. JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) and CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) are continuation watches.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
The strongest supplied positive catalysts were a favorable CHMP opinion for a healthcare treatment (+55) and analyst upgrades in technology and materials (+50 each). Their corresponding 1W/1M returns were not included in the supplied key-stock data, so price confirmation or divergence cannot be assessed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-80): negative coverage around leadership and downside risk; BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%), confirming weakness. META (-70): reported Italian fine; in RECOVERY (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -12.90%), a short-term bounce diverging from negative news and the monthly trend.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with style mixed / no clear leadership: all 11/11 sectors are positive, but leadership is intermediate and major stock divergences temper conviction. CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) and JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) show relative strength. Monitor the major divergence and negative sentiment around NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%); trend confirmation remains limited.
